description: List the starter templates, each with a live preview_url and the fields that can be filled in: free ones (café, portfolio, product landing page, link in bio, wedding, tradesperson, CV, coming soon, blog, gaming sites) and premium ones (premium: true: software launch, design studio, fine dining, coach, botanical wedding, esports team) with their own fonts, illustration and motion. No account needed to list or preview them. Premium ones are included with press5 web hosting and need a token from an account that has it. Deploy one with deploy_site { template, fields }, or call get_template to fetch its files and change them first.
name: list_templates
title: Starter templates
